verdict.rationale: Radar has real API resources: reviews can be approved via POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve, value lists can be managed, and early fraud warnings are exposed. However, custom rules, risk settings, fraud analytics and the review queue are documented only as Dashboard features, and a community user cites a lack of easy programmatic control. Missing for 10: documented API for creating and editing rules, API for risk settings and fraud-insights analytics, any evidence of full API/UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Value lists allow you to group values together which can then be referenced in rules.
An early fraud warning indicates that the card issuer has notified us that a charge may be fraudulent.
